title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 12: the place Yahweh will choose, eating meat at home and the rule about the blood.

questions.text: Where had the nations served their gods, according to Deuteronomy 12:2?
questions.explanation: They were to destroy all the places where the nations served their gods: on the high mountains, on the hills and under every green tree.

answers.text: Only inside great temples of stone
On high mountains, hills and under every green tree
In caves by the shore of the sea
On the flat roofs of their houses

questions.text: Where were they to bring their burnt offerings, sacrifices and tithes?
questions.explanation: They were to seek the place Yahweh would choose out of all their tribes to put his name there, and bring their offerings there.

answers.text: To any high hill they liked
To the house of each family
To the nearest city gate
To the place Yahweh would choose

questions.text: Which practice does Moses say they must not continue in the land?
questions.explanation: They were not to do all the things they were doing "here today," every man whatever is right in his own eyes.

answers.text: Every man doing whatever is right in his own eyes
Gathering manna every morning
Living in tents in the wilderness
Traveling at night by the cloud

questions.text: Why does Deuteronomy 12:12 include the Levite in the rejoicing before Yahweh?
questions.explanation: They are to rejoice with the Levite within their gates, because he has no portion nor inheritance with them.

answers.text: He is the oldest in the house
He brought the sacrifice himself
He has no portion or inheritance with them
He came with them from Egypt

questions.text: Meat eaten within their gates is to be eaten like which animals?
questions.explanation: They may kill and eat meat within their gates; the unclean and the clean may eat of it, as of the gazelle and the deer.

answers.text: The ox and the sheep
The gazelle and the deer
The goat and the lamb
The dove and the pigeon

questions.text: What were they to do with the blood when they killed meat within their gates?
questions.explanation: They may kill and eat meat within their gates, but not eat the blood; they shall pour it out on the earth like water.

answers.text: Pour it out on the earth like water
Drink it together with the meat
Burn it in the fire outside the camp
Give it to the Levite to eat

questions.text: What may they do if the place Yahweh chooses is too far from them?
questions.explanation: If the place is too far, they may kill from their herd and flock and eat within their gates, after all the desire of their soul.

answers.text: Eat no meat at all for that year
Build their own altar at home
Send their animals along with a Levite
Kill from their herd and flock and eat at home

questions.text: Why must they not eat the blood, according to Deuteronomy 12:23?
questions.explanation: They must be sure not to eat the blood, for the blood is the life, and they shall not eat the life with the meat.

answers.text: Because it belongs to the priests
Because it makes the meat bitter
Because the blood is the life
Because the nations drink it

questions.text: What does Deuteronomy 12:31 say the nations even did to their sons and daughters?
questions.explanation: The nations did every abomination to their gods; they even burned their sons and their daughters in the fire to their gods.

answers.text: They burned them in the fire to their gods
They sold them to Egypt
They sent them into the wilderness
They gave them as servants to kings

questions.text: What must they not do with whatever Moses commands, according to Deuteronomy 12:32?
questions.explanation: Whatever Moses commands they must observe to do; they shall not add to it, nor take away from it.

answers.text: Speak it at the city gates
Write it on their hands
Teach it to strangers
Add to it or take away from it
